policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV reads "a servant of Jesus Christ", matching the order Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ; the base Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ would give "Christ Jesus". Word order is rendered here, so the English distinguishes the reading.

ASV "I thank my God ... for you all" renders either περὶ or ὑπὲρ identically. The only note is classed alternative_rendering ("Or, because"), which concerns English wording and cannot decide a reading. Base fallback περὶ carries the projection.

ASV reads "not ashamed of the gospel:" with no qualifier; the addition τοῦ χριστοῦ would require "of the gospel of Christ". The absence of substantive words the ASV elsewhere renders distinguishes the shorter reading.

The variant is only the order of θεὸς and the postpositive γὰρ; ASV "for God manifested it unto them" is the same English under either, since γάρ must move to English clause-initial position regardless. No note is mapped here.

ASV "Wherefore God gave them up" shows no "also", but the ASV routinely leaves a connective καί after an inferential particle unrendered, so its absence does not distinguish Διὸ from Διὸ καὶ. No note is mapped here; base fallback Διὸ carries the projection.
ASV "dishonored among themselves" renders both αὐτοῖς and the reflexive ἑαυτοῖς as "themselves"; English has no form that separates them here, and no note is mapped to this unit.
ἑαυτοῖς and αὑτοῖς are orthographic variants of the same reflexive pronoun; ASV "receiving in themselves" renders either without distinction, and no note is mapped here.

The ASV vice list runs "all unrighteousness, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness" with no term for πορνείᾳ; the ASV renders that noun ("fornication") wherever it stands, so its absence distinguishes the shorter reading.

ASV reads "covenant-breakers, without natural affection, unmerciful" — three terms, with nothing answering to ἀσπόνδους ("implacable"). The added substantive is unrendered, which distinguishes the shorter reading.
